_comment: Brawl Stars 70.757 iOS arm64. Byte offsets unless prefixed *_va (module-relative). Leave values null: overlay boots resolve.js against the live process and measures the actor table, layout, matrix and hp store itself. Fill them only to pin a layout you have already confirmed with Frameworks/scan.js.

notes.damage_entry_va: x0 = attacker, x1 = victim, w2 = damage int. Returns bool. FILL from xref on the victim HP subtract.
notes.attack_command_va: x0 = command struct; +0x00 aim_x float, +0x04 aim_y float. FILL from xref on the touch->command builder.
notes.tick_update_va: called once per logic frame; used as the overlay clock. FILL from the frame driver.
notes.actor_array: absolute pointer at runtime — never bake an allocation address into a file
